reason: The hypothesis combines the use of Y2O3 nanoparticle inoculants (from P23/P42 on NiCoCr) with the specific problem of silicon segregation and residual stress in cobalt-free AlCrFeNiSi during AM, a combination not proposed or studied in any passage.
